invariants.rule: Topic match alone cannot support ACCEPT
ACCEPT requires positive commercial evidence
Conflicting protected signal may require ABSTAIN
Unresolved high ambiguity cannot ACCEPT
REJECT requires a reason code
ABSTAIN requires an unresolved question or conflict
Every decision requires provenance
Every automated decision records rule/model/prompt versions
Service ownership cannot be final before ACCEPT
Cluster or campaign fields are forbidden
Export fields are forbidden
Human override must retain prior decision
Superseded records remain auditable
Narrative fields cannot contain raw numeric sentinels
Primary intent and eligibility must not be conflated
Workflow status and eligibility must not be conflated
Product/module intent cannot silently map to service intent
UNKNOWN cannot automatically become ACCEPT
Malformed query cannot be rewritten into a new commercial query
ABSTAIN is a valid terminal output for automated processing
